Page 251 Cont.
Dec. 18 James Pentkowski - 12 - rhumatic fever almost a yr. Drs. baffled (See July 26 nect)
Page 252 For Christmas Day 1940
Dec. 25 Theodore Weunski - 40- fell 45 feet off a scaffold - in very bad con- dition - has three children and an invalid wife.
Mrs. M. Churilla - 33 - Heart - and intestinal trouble on her back now six weeks. Miracle necessary and her
Mrs. Stella Greiner - hopeless cancer
Victor C. Moore - 49 - fearful Eczema in Delray Hospital Mrs. Meade - has quite a family - neighbors fear loss of George Riedon - 48 - threatening anoth. near apendix -
26 John Hoeller - 32 - has family - wife and twin sons - nerveous
28 Thanks - Wm. A. Shiffmann - 68 - 52 years away from Church and Sacra- ments. Always however, went to holy Mass on Christmas; became very ill Eve of great feast, was prepared for death - last great journey - Received Holy Communion and Extreme Unction and died on joyful Feast itself.
Page 253 Dec. 28 Tho's Moore - 50 - non C. - sprained sholder two months ago. . .... not improving as it should.
Mary V. Hayes - 19 - T.B. given very little hope of recovery - down to about 70 lbs.
31 Thanks - Mrs. Clara Barnes - 35 - Very threatening condition from tuomer - down to 75 1bs. - had been 12 yrs sickly - never weighed 106 - now is 130 - Husband Swedish lutheran ... quite decided ... promised when all hope of recovery had vanished that he would look earnestly into religion if wife were spared. next morning, Dr's and all were positively astonished ..... Deo Gr.
Carl Ricard - 39 - Fractured skull four yrs. ago ... now again poorly.
